description: A convoy commander must approve the loading plan for three support modules on one heavy trailer, including each module's position, loading sequence, handling method, and required checks before dispatch.

shared_context.S1: One heavy trailer is available for the communications shelter, water tank module, and generator module scheduled for delivery to the forward support area.
shared_context.S2: The trailer has three designated positions: front, center, and rear, and the convoy departs at 1600 tomorrow.
shared_context.S3: The standard movement-control procedure requires a written load plan, a pre-dispatch height check, and an axle-balance check before the trailer is released.
shared_context.S4: Capt. Morgan holds the routine pre-movement load-planning review with the loadmaster, route liaison, and maintenance chief before approving the board.
shared_context.S5: The draft manifest lists the communications shelter in the front position, the water tank module in the center position, and the generator module in the rear position.

PF1.text: Sgt. Patel reweighed the communications shelter this morning and confirmed it is 8,400 pounds rather than the 6,000 pounds shown on the draft manifest; placing it in the center position is required for axle balance, but the corrected scale ticket has not yet been attached to the movement packet.

PF2.text: Lt. Alvarez confirmed with the receiving site that the water tank's vent cap raises its loaded height to 13 feet, while the approved access structure allows only 12 feet 6 inches; the vent cap must be removed and secured before movement, and the site confirmation has not yet been added to the load-planning slide.

PF3.text: SFC Brooks found during this morning's inspection that the generator module's lifting eye is not serviceable, so it must be loaded with the side-forklift rather than the trailer crane; the only qualified forklift crew is booked at 1400, and the maintenance note has not yet been posted to the movement board.

acceptance_conditions: The communications shelter must be placed in the center position because its confirmed weight is 8,400 pounds.
The water tank must be placed in the rear position and its vent cap must be removed and secured before movement.
The generator must be placed in the front position and loaded with the side-forklift.
The generator must be loaded first at the 1400 forklift appointment, followed by the communications shelter and then the water tank.
Both the pre-dispatch height check and axle-balance check must be retained in the plan.
The corrected communications-shelter weight must be cited as a justification.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'vent_cap_control' and c['target'] == 'water tank module' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'forklift_coordination' and c['target'] == 'generator module' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The corrected 8,400-pound weight changes the communications shelter from the draft front position to the required center position and supplies the specific fact that must be cited.
The 13-foot vented height changes the water tank from the draft center position to the rear position and requires the vent-cap removal and securing commitment.

The failed lifting eye changes the generator to the front position, replaces crane loading with side-forklift handling, fixes its first loading position at the 1400 appointment, and requires forklift coordination.
